statement.zh: 前古典低地存在大型纪念性/城市—仪式复合体（纳克贝、埃尔米拉多尔等），通论中描述为前古典峰值。
statement.en: Preclassic lowlands host large monumental / urban–ritual complexes (Nakbe, El Mirador, etc.), described in surveys as Preclassic florescence peaks.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
